meaning: Closes the #173 open premise STMT-MAXIME-ENS-IS-GOD (owner decision on #143, 2026-10-24): the maximum in being is unique, causes the being of all others, and so is what the name 'God' is given to by its explicit, sourced nominal definition (q.13 a.8 ad 2; quarta via, et hoc dicimus Deum). The identification is nominal. Countermodels show that the definition and uniqueness (hence Metaphysics II.1) are each needed.
